trust_decision.summary: The access token must be taken only from the `Authorization` header: a `?token=` query value must never be decoded or make the authenticator claim the request. Decided in the Authorizer's token extraction and in its supports() gate.

landing_point.why: The summary says bearer tokens were accepted from the URL query, so an engineer looks first at the authorizer's token extraction, where `$request->query->get('token')` is preferred over the Authorization header and reaches the SDK decode() at :62.

fix_sites.entry_point: Symfony security firewall authenticator `auth0.authorizer` (registered src/Auth0Bundle.php:197-201, listed under `custom_authenticators` in a stateless firewall, README.md:139-144); Symfony calls authenticate() for each request on that firewall
Same firewall authenticator, supports() gate that decides whether authenticate() runs for the request

O3_reason_to_dismiss: n/a at the pinned commit: the query-token path has one site and no second route, so there is no site a solver could argue out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The OAuth login callback legitimately carries `code` and `state` in the query string, and login() redirects the browser to that callback route; an over-broad 'no credentials in URLs' fix (or one that rejects query strings on the affected routes) breaks the SDK's own login flow. Header tokens must also keep working for stateless firewalls.

O6_input_shapes: `?token=<jwt>` query parameter as a plain string (the advisory's example)
`?token[]=a` query parameter as an array, which reached the is_string guard at src/Security/Authorizer.php:49 before the fix and now never reaches the sink
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` with a case-insensitive prefix (stripos), retained
header value with leading/trailing whitespace (trim at src/Security/Authorizer.php:42), retained
token text containing the literal 'bearer ' internally, which the old str_ireplace mangled and the fix's substr() leaves intact

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The callback controller also accepts a bare access token from the query (e.g. `?access_token=`) as a session-handoff shortcut instead of the code/state exchange
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The controller already consumes credential material from the query string (code, state) and a maintainer adding a SPA handoff would naturally put the token there too.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A query-string fallback for `logout_token` alongside the current POST-body read
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handler already normalises one credential input (trim, empty check) and maintainers commonly add a query fallback for testing or for senders that cannot POST.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A `?token=` fallback in the stateful authenticator when no SDK session exists
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: supports() returns true for every request (:80-83), so a maintainer could treat a request token as a second way to build the stateful Passport.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A public `getAccessToken(Request)` helper on the bundle's Service that reads the current request's query for convenience
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Service is the bundle's public wrapper around the Auth0 SDK and already reads the current request in warmUp() (:41-51); a convenience accessor there is a natural place for a maintainer to put token resolution.

O9_family: sensitive information exposure / credential in URL (CWE-200, CWE-598)

O10_build.toolchain: Composer; Pest/PHPUnit (phpunit.xml.dist:10-12); PHPStan, Psalm, Rector, php-cs-fixer, composer-validate in CI (.github/workflows/tests.yml:53-179)
O10_build.project_tests: Unit suite wired at phpunit.xml.dist:10-12 with tests/Pest.php:7 bootstrapping vendor/autoload.php, but the only test file is tests/Unit/Models/UserTest.php; there is no test for src/Security/Authorizer.php and the fix diff adds none. The example app under `examples/6.4 LTS` configures Redis but is not part of the package build.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep the `?token=` fallback but validate it more strictly (is_string / JWT shape) in authenticate(), or remove only the extract-then-decode branch while leaving supports() claiming query-token requests.

unverified: Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell in this session); the tracked tree is ~116 files with no vendor/ or asset directory, so tiny_repo is inferred, not measured.

No vendor/ directory exists at the pinned commit, so the Auth0 PHP SDK's decode()/getCredentials() internals could not be read to rule out a second query-token path inside the dependency (outside this repository's scope).

Whether the Authorizer can be exercised fully offline after the build is not verified: decode() fetches JWKS over the network unless a token cache or a mock PSR-18 client is injected (composer.json:48 ships php-http/mock-client).

`single_site` is applied because both hunks are the same check inside one final class and there is no O2 site or O8 route; strictly the fix touches two methods (authenticate and supports) in one file, not literally one function.
